title: Run a one-off CLI command as a trust zone
caption: deploy/scripts/run-as.sh (velexis-run). The command gets the zone unit's user, env files, working directory and sandbox; never the migrator DSN.

steps.title: Pick the zone
steps.expect: Backend zones get both env files of their worker.

steps.title: Grant the first platform admin
steps.body: `sudo velexis-run platform node dist/cli.js admin:grant <email>` (the account must be verified and have MFA on).
steps.expect: Exit code is the command's; `125` means velexis-run refused (bad zone, unit not installed, no release folder). An unknown e-mail prints `No account has the e-mail address <email>; nothing changed.`

steps.title: Create the production demo OTA
steps.body: `sudo velexis-run platform node dist/cli.js tenants:create-demo <email> --country <code> --currency <code> --time-zone <zone>` (owner with MFA; key `demo`, out of billing).
steps.expect: `demo.<STOREFRONT_BASE_DOMAIN>` gets a certificate; the health check's payment pages and the uptime monitor can use it.

steps.title: Run a tenant backfill
steps.expect: One line per schema, `… <n> scrubbed of <m> read (<k> changed meanwhile, left for another run)`, then `<x> of <y> tenant schema(s) scrubbed.`; a second run scrubs 0.
